Privacy Policy

We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to provide the service. We will not share, exchange, or sell your email address and other provided personal information to anyone.

California residents have the right to know the categories of personal information sold or shared. By "sharing", we mean a disclosure of personal information to a third party for cross-context behavioural advertising. You have the right to opt out of automated decision-making under some consumer privacy laws.

If we are involved in a merger, acquisition or sale of company assets, your information may be transferred. We may update this policy from time to time. Shine the Light: California residents may request a list of third parties who received data for their own marketing purposes.

Sensitive personal information means data revealing precise geolocation, health condition or biometric data. The Digital Advertising Alliance offers an industry opt-out of inferences about your interests. We may disclose information to law enforcement when required. We use biometric data of our employees for building access.

Our Services are not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect information from children. Your rights include requesting that we delete your data, which we honour.

You and we agree to resolve any dispute by binding arbitration. If we sold your personal information, we will provide two lists on request. You may request the categories we share with third parties for their marketing purposes.
